execution_boundary.currencies: Both released currency identities, scopes and reset rules lower through closed typed values. Validated credit/spend/reset commands execute atomically through GraphActivity; stale, rule-mismatched and unfunded commands are byte-inert, and run finalization clears the currency map.
execution_boundary.constants: All 18 simulation-visible common constants lower to checked integer, integer-array or opaque-text values; all 16 account/reward/presentation/test exclusions remain absent from runtime projection.
execution_boundary.caller_snapshot: Entry requires an immutable account/loadout snapshot sealed to the exact participant lock. Full digests bind the Activity configuration; private slots retain stable state projections.
execution_boundary.save: Capture is read-only over canonical GraphActivity bytes and validates current component, definition, input, participant, state and envelope digests.
execution_boundary.settlement: Completed Activities expose immutable progression/account-consumer inputs while retaining no authority to query or mutate account state.
execution_boundary.deferred: Canonical-byte reconstruction and resume are owned by G22-P7-B5; malformed load/replay suites are owned by G22-P8-B1.
execution_boundary.credit: Economy, immutable snapshot and settlement boundaries only; no service execution, save reconstruction, encounter, battle, full playable-run or release-gate credit.

persistence_contract.capture: Save is a read-only canonical snapshot operation and cannot advance state, consume RNG or materialize a new offer.
persistence_contract.future_load: Load reconstructs fresh immutable catalogs and registries, verifies the exact current component set and all embedded identities, then resumes the same offered decision.
persistence_contract.rejection: Unknown components, digest mismatch, malformed bounds, stale handoff or noncanonical order fail before a live session exists.
persistence_contract.compatibility: Only the current tree and current runtime identity are supported; no legacy decoder or migration branch is retained.
persistence_contract.implemented_now: Read-only capture and fresh-current-input validation before any live reconstructed session exists.
